_comment: Expected parse of each .diff in this directory. Hand-verified against the diff text,
NOT generated from the parser — a generated expectation only asserts that the parser
This corpus is SHARED with MagmaMoose/chargate, whose sarif/diff.py is near-identical
to brimyr's coverage/diff.py. The two parsers are deliberately duplicated rather than
extracted into a package (see MagmaMoose/brimyr#33); this corpus plus CORPUS.sha256 is
the anti-drift device that replaces the coupling. Edit a fixture here and the checksum
test fails until you update the hash — which is the moment to copy the change across.
added_ranges are inclusive (start, end) pairs on the NEW side of the diff.

mixed.diff.note: One real `git diff --unified=0` covering add, rename+edit, delete, a path with spaces, no-newline-at-EOF, two disjoint single-line hunks, and a multi-line hunk.

after_rename.py.note: Renamed AND edited. Keyed by the NEW path — a coverage report references the new file.

delete_me.py.note: Deleting code is not an untested change; no added ranges, and patch.py skips it.

dir with spaces/quoted name.py.note: git appends a TAB to the +++ line when the path contains spaces. The tab must not survive into the path.

eof.py.note: The trailing `\ No newline at end of file` marker must not be read as a hunk line.

modify.py.note: Two disjoint single-line hunks. They must stay separate, not merge into (2,5) — lines 3 and 4 are unchanged and must not enter the denominator.

edge.diff.note: A binary change and a mode-only change. Neither carries line information, so NOTHING coverable changed and the index must be empty. A file appearing here would silently enter the denominator with no lines.
